news.snippet: # Kimi developer Moonshot AI valued at US$20b as it navigates China’s new IPO ru...
news.raw_snippet: # Kimi developer Moonshot AI valued at US$20b as it navigates China’s new IPO rules. ### The company raised US$2 billion from investors including Meituan and China Mobile, taking the total to US$3.9 billion in the last six months. Moonshot AI, best known for its Kimi chatbot, saw its annual recurring revenue exceed US$200 million in April. Chinese artificial intelligence start-up Moonshot AI has raised about US$2 billion in a new funding round, boosting its valuation to more than US$20 billion as it navigates Beijing’s new listing rules for companies registered overseas. Over the past six months, Moonshot had raised a total of US$3.9 billion, according to a statement by the deal’s financial adviser HF Capital on Thursday. The Beijing-based company, best known for its Kimi chatbot, saw its annual recurring revenue (ARR) exceed US$200 million in April, the statement said. Moonshot’s valuation of US$20 billion “still has significant room for growth” as the market caps of its Hong Kong-listed peers Zhipu AI, traded as Knowledge Atlas Technology, and MiniMax, were much higher, according to HF Capital.

news.title: Open-source AI developer Moonshot AI raises $2B at $20B+ valuation
news.snippet: Chinese artificial intelligence lab Moonshot AI has raised $2 billion in funding...
news.raw_snippet: Chinese artificial intelligence lab Moonshot AI has raised $2 billion in funding at a valuation exceeding $20 billion. TechCrunch reported the deal today, citing a social media post from an investment advisory firm that was involved in the deal. The investment comes a few weeks after Moonshot AI released its newest AI model. Kimi-K2.6 is an open-source large language model with about 1 trillion parameters. When an LLM receives a prompt, it uses a so-called attention mechanism to identify and prioritize the most important parts of the request. The attention mechanism stores its findings in a data structure known as a KV cache. One of Kimi-K2.6’s flagship features is a module that compresses its KV cache into a latent space, an abstract mathematical representation with a smaller memory footprint. One of them is Kimi-VL, an open-source vision-language model optimized to process visual data. Moonshot AI monetizes its open-source technologies with a paid chatbot service called Kimi.

news.title: CEOs Say AI Gives Them Only Two Options, and Both Are Bad News for Employees
news.snippet: # CEOs Say AI Gives Them Only Two Options, and Both Are Bad News for Employees. ...
news.raw_snippet: # CEOs Say AI Gives Them Only Two Options, and Both Are Bad News for Employees. A person sitting at a desk with a laptop, holding their head in their hands, appearing stressed or frustrated. In an age of AI, our hardworking CEOs are being tortured with a tough decision, according to new *Wall Street Journal* reporting: they can embrace AI and lay off scores of employees — or keep their employees, but use AI to make them work even harder. But it’s emblematic of the logic that business leaders, gripped by AI fomo, are operating with. Exemplifying this logic, Spotify co-CEO Gustav Söderström opined during a recent earnings call that businesses can either translate AI “straight into cost savings and cut headcount,” or they could “say we’re going to be roughly the same amount of people, we ‘re just going to do more.”. **More on AI:** *Ordinary People Fear AI, While the Tech Leaders Working to Create a Permanent Underclass Say They’re Extremely Psyched About It*.
